description: This file defines a NestJS pipe class 'GoogleCalendarEventOutputPipe' that transforms a Google Calendar event response object into a unified internal event output format. It includes methods for mapping response statuses, event statuses, locations, and attendees, and handles conference data and hangout links.

classes.name: GoogleCalendarEventOutputPipe
classes.description: A NestJS pipe that transforms Google Calendar event responses into a unified internal format.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms a GoogleCalendarEventResponse object into a UnifiedCalendarEventOutput object.

methods.name: transformDateTimeWithZone
methods.description: Converts Google dateTime and timezone into a DateTimeWithZone object.

methods.name: transformAttendeeResponseStatus
methods.description: Maps Google attendee response status string to internal CalendarEventResponseStatus enum.

methods.name: transformEventStatus
methods.description: Maps Google event status string to internal CalendarEventStatus enum.

methods.name: transformHosts
methods.description: Extracts and maps hosts (organizers) from the Google event attendees.

methods.name: transformLocations
methods.description: Determines event location URLs from conference data, location, or hangout link.
